correctness.rationale: Reconstructed parent support function sum of two largest coordinate moduli and three proper-face types: coordinate cross-polytope facets, fixed-leading-index simplices and signed hypersimplex faces. In a signed/permutation chamber normal with |u_1|>...>|u_n|, each root ±e_i±e_j has sign governed by earlier index. Every crossing parent face contributes one section face of dimension one less. Explicit counts of crossing dimension-d simplices d*2^(d+2)C(n,d+2) and hypersimplices (2^(d+1)-4)C(n,d+1), plus 2(n-1) coordinate facets, yield complete stated formula. Independent Euler and endpoint checks n5..12 agree. Already established chamber rigidity and endpoint face counts are credited, not discoveries.
